sections.h1: A social presence that *feeds your funnel*
sections.lead: Posting is not a strategy. We align your social media with your offer and your conversion pages, with experts from our network, so every post moves a customer closer to a decision.

brief.t: service businesses, consultants, coaches and SaaS companies that want more credibility and inquiries.
content strategy, positioning, links to your conversion pages and tracking.
LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and others, depending on your audience.
content serves the offer — not the other way around.

sections.text: Holding space isn't enough: you need to *feed the funnel.*
prose: Many companies post regularly without seeing results, because their content isn't tied to a clear offer or to a page that converts.
We start from your offer and your ideal customers, then build a coherent presence: a recognizable voice, topics that answer real questions and a clear path to getting in touch.

items.p: Editorial pillars, topics and formats aligned with your offer and your ideal customers' questions.
A recognizable tone and message, consistent with your site and campaigns.
Profiles and pages completed to build trust and steer visitors to your conversion page.
A realistic publishing rhythm, planned ahead, that you can actually sustain.
Visuals, copy and short videos produced with experts from our network, according to your budget.
Tracked links (UTM) to your pages so you know which content generates real inquiries.

steps.p: We clarify your offer, your audience and your goals.
We choose the networks, topics and formats.
Content is created and published on schedule.
We measure the effect on visits, inquiries and relationships.

sections.h2: Posting to post or *posting to convert?*

items: Topics chosen at random or by habit
No link to the offer or to a conversion page
Topics drawn from your customers' real questions
Every piece leads to a clear next step

sections.p: Tell us who you want to reach; we'll build the presence that gets there.

faq.q: Which social networks should I be on?
a: The ones where your ideal customers are and where you can keep a realistic rhythm. For B2B or professional services, LinkedIn is often the priority; Facebook and Instagram suit other audiences better. We determine this during framing.

faq.q: Do you create the content for me?
a: We define the strategy and editorial line, then produce or coordinate the content with experts from our network, according to your budget and the time you want to invest.

faq.q: What's the difference between organic and paid social media?
a: Organic content builds credibility and relationships over time; paid accelerates reach toward a specific offer. They work best together. See our [digital advertising](@publicite) service.

faq.q: How do I know if my social media is working?
a: We track visits, inquiries and conversations coming from each network, beyond likes. If a piece of content leads to no action, we adjust.
